_comment: Bundled model capability overrides. These patch known gaps in provider metadata. Entries with an 'expires' date are temporary workarounds that should be reviewed and removed after that date.

overrides.reason: OpenRouter /api/v1/models does not yet populate supported_parameters with tools/tool_choice for Gemma 4 entries. Max tools capped at 15 — Gemma 4 is prone to tool-call hallucination loops with large tool sets.
Ollama v0.20.0 has a broken Gemma 4 chat template for tool calls. The workaround uses /api/generate with raw control tokens.
Same Ollama workaround as gemma4:* but with explicit ollama/ prefix.
